utfall: grein 2: andel 30-åringer med fullført høyere utdanning, økning fra 30 prosent (kull 1965–1969) til 48 prosent (kull 1985–1989)
sitat: In total, 30 per cent of the 30 years old in the 1965–1969 birth cohort had HE, while for the birth cohort 20 years afterwards (1985–1989), the corresponding percentage was 48 per cent.

utfall: grein 2: lavere sannsynlighet for høyere utdanning ved 30 år for ungdom fra distriktet, kull 1989 (gapet har økt over tid)
sitat: our results suggest that students from urban areas have an approximately 18 percentage points greater probability of having HE by age 30 than students from the countryside.

utfall: grein 2: forskjell i sannsynlighet for høyere utdanning ved 30 år etter kontroll for familieressurser (modell 4), kull 1989
gruppe: oppvokst i distrikt, justert for familieressurser
sitat: After taking family resources into account in Model 4, urban students were approximately 9 per cent (capital area) and 2 per cent (major cities) more likely to attain HE compared to students from the countryside
